description: Source code for px5g, an embedded X.509 key and certificate generator based on PolarSSL, including functions for key generation, certificate creation, and command-line interface.

methods.name: _urandom
methods.description: Reads random bytes from /dev/urandom into the output buffer.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file or stdout, handling PEM and DER formats.

methods.name: ecp_curve
methods.description: Returns the elliptic curve group ID based on the curve name.

methods.name: write_key
methods.description: Writes a cryptographic key to a file in PEM or DER format.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Generates an RSA or EC private key based on parameters.

methods.name: dokey
methods.description: Handles command-line arguments to generate a key pair.

methods.name: selfsigned
methods.description: Creates a self-signed X.509 certificate with specified parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the utility, parsing arguments and invoking key or certificate generation.
